channel.title: NoneNote
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
release: 1.3.2 — staple the app before packaging

1.3.1 shipped a DMG whose app had no notarization ticket of its own, so a
first launch on a machine that was offline would have been refused. This
release is that fix; the version bump keeps the repo's declared version in
step with what the tag publishes.
